title: Code of Practice for Design Loads (Other Than Earthquake) - Imposed Loads

clauses.title: Residential Buildings Imposed Loads
clauses.text: Living rooms, bedrooms: 2.0 kN/m2. Kitchens, dining rooms: 2.0 kN/m2. Corridors, passages, staircases, store rooms: 3.0 kN/m2. Balconies: 3.0 kN/m2.

clauses.title: Educational Buildings Imposed Loads
clauses.text: Classrooms and lecture rooms: 3.0 kN/m2. Dining rooms, cafeterias: 3.0 kN/m2. Assembly halls with fixed seats: 4.0 kN/m2; without fixed seats: 5.0 kN/m2. Library reading rooms: 3.0 to 4.0 kN/m2; Book stacks: 6.0 to 10.0 kN/m2.

clauses.title: Institutional & Hospital Buildings Imposed Loads
clauses.text: Bedrooms, wards: 2.0 kN/m2. Dressing rooms, consultation rooms: 2.5 kN/m2. Operating theatres, ICU, X-ray rooms: 3.0 kN/m2. Corridors, waiting areas: 4.0 kN/m2.

clauses.title: Office Buildings Imposed Loads
clauses.text: General offices: 2.5 kN/m2. Office entrance halls and banking halls: 3.0 kN/m2. Office rooms with storage/filing: 4.0 kN/m2. Vaults and strong rooms: 5.0 kN/m2.

clauses.title: Mercantile & Commercial Buildings Imposed Loads
clauses.text: Retail shops and department stores: 4.0 kN/m2. Wholesale shops and showrooms: 5.0 kN/m2. Storage and warehouses: 5.0 to 10.0 kN/m2 based on stacking height.

clauses.title: Reduction in Imposed Loads for Multi-Storey Columns
clauses.text: For columns supporting more than one floor in multi-storey buildings, imposed load reduction factor: 1 floor = 0%, 2 floors = 10%, 3 floors = 20%, 4 floors = 30%, 5 to 10 floors = 40%, over 10 floors = 50% maximum reduction.
